newsitem.title: USA: Satcon sees Q4 shr loss $0.15 to $0.18.
newsitem.headline: Satcon sees Q4 shr loss $0.15 to $0.18.

text.p: SatCon Technology Corp on Thursday said it expected to post a net loss of $0.15 to $0.18 per share for the fourth quarter ended September 30.
The company said it expected to report revenue of $1.8 million for the quarter.
The results are expected to be released during the week of December 16.

The firm said fourth quarter results included costs incurred for the continued development of two commercial products set for 1997 introduction and for acquisition efforts related to K&D Magmotor, a Massachusetts-based firm.
